tha-ap89:1.1: Phaladāyaka.] Pabbate Himavantamhi kharājinadharo ahaṃ / Phussaṃ jinavaraṃ disvā phalahattho phalaṃ adaṃ // //
tha-ap89:2.1: Yam ahaṃ phalam adāsiṃ vippasannena cetasā / bhave nibbattamānamhi phalaṃ nibbattate mamaṃ. // //
tha-ap89:3.1: Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ phalam adadim ahaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi phaladānass' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap89:4.1: Paṭisambhidā catasso vimokhā pi ca aṭṭh' ime / chaḍabhiññā sacchikatā kataṃ Buddhassa sasanan
tha-ap89:5.1: ti. // // Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Phaladāyakothero imā gāthāyo abhāsitthā ti.
